title: 3D Clusters, Glass Layouts, Bounded Type, Chroma Lens & Odometers
description: Five live drops: an interactive particle cluster, a glass panel layout composer, mask-bounded text reveals, a chromatic-aberration cursor lens, and slot-roll stat cards.

drops.title: Cluster Assembly
drops.description: An interactive particle cluster that snaps between sphere, torus, grid and scatter formations with springy easing.
drops.concept: Hundreds of nodes ease toward procedurally computed target positions for each formation (Fibonacci sphere, torus parametrization, grid, scatter), with a faint pseudo-depth glow and proximity-linked edges. Clicking sends a radial impulse through nearby nodes; hovering repels them.
drops.source: Creating an Interactive 3D Cluster with Three.js, TSL and Three Start — Codrops

drops.title: Glass Panel Composer
drops.description: Three switchable multi-panel frosted-glass arrangements over a drifting animated gradient.
drops.concept: A single set of five glass cards is re-parented across three CSS Grid template definitions (signature, dashboard, profile) purely via class swap, while blur intensity and gradient hue stay live-tunable through CSS custom properties.

interaction.mouse: click layout buttons to re-flow the grid
interaction.click: sliders retint and reblur the glass live

drops.title: Bounded Reveal
drops.description: Mask-based headline reveals where every character stays clipped inside its own word box.
drops.concept: Each word is wrapped in an overflow:hidden span acting as a bounding mask, with an inner span that translates, blurs or rotates into place — so characters only ever appear to emerge from within their own final footprint, never fly in from outside it.

interaction.mouse: hover the third headline to replay its letter stagger
interaction.touch: tap the headline to replay on mobile

drops.title: Chroma Lens
drops.description: A cursor-following magnifier with true per-channel chromatic aberration.
drops.concept: A pixel-level lens samples a magnified crop of the background three times — once per RGB channel, each with a small horizontal pixel offset — and recombines them into one ImageData region clipped to a circle, square or diamond, reproducing real chromatic-aberration glass.
drops.source: Building a Mouse-Following Square Lens Effect with Three.js and GLSL — Codrops

interaction.mouse: move over the field to reveal the lens
interaction.click: shape buttons swap the lens silhouette
interaction.touch: drag a finger across the field on mobile

drops.title: Odometer Stat Cards
drops.description: A dashboard of live KPI cards where every digit rolls independently, slot-machine style.
drops.concept: Each digit is its own vertical strip of 0-9 that translates to the target row on update, with a small per-column delay so digits cascade left-to-right like a real odometer, reframing a slot-roll number library as a live dashboard widget.

interaction.mouse: click Simulate Update to roll all cards
interaction.click: type a custom value to roll to it
interaction.touch: buttons and inputs work identically on mobile
